# Idea SM Project Ltd

> Idea SM Project Ltd is a limited company registered in Cyprus that invests in, develops and launches exhibitions and museums worldwide. It finances, develops and launches immersive exhibitions, permanent museums and touring exhibitions, working with venues, cities, brand owners and co-investors, with a focus on Europe.

## Facts
- Legal name: Idea SM Project Ltd (brand: Idea SM Project)
- Legal form and country: limited company (Ltd), registered in Cyprus
- Role: acts as an investor in projects; it is not a regulated investment fund
- Activity: investment in, development and launch of exhibitions and museums
- Formats: immersive exhibitions; museums (science, nature, art, culture); touring exhibitions
- Audience of its projects: all ages, including families and children
- Geography: worldwide; partners across Europe
- Role in projects: capital partner, co-developer or operator
- Process: invest, develop, launch, grow

## Next opening
- Project: Disgusting Food Museum Vilnius
- Date: 21 December 2026
- Place: Vilnius, Lithuania
